title: Law 4628 sets up the regulator and the first electricity market framework
label: Law 4628
name_tr: Enerji Piyasası Düzenleme Kurumunun Teşkilat ve Görevleri Hakkında Kanun (4628)
effect: Established EPDK. Per the handbook it also split TEAŞ into EÜAŞ (generation), TEİAŞ (transmission) and TETAŞ (wholesale), introduced the free consumer and foresaw a market financial settlement centre (PMUM). The page now lists 4628 under the title of the EPDK organisation law; Law 6446 still calls it the Electricity Market Law.
source_note: Header read (number, adoption date, gazette date). Effects: handbook section 2. The rename of the law's title was not traced to its own instrument.

title: Electricity sector reform and privatisation strategy paper
label: Reform strategy (2004)
effect: Action plan as summarised by TEPAV: privatise distribution first, then generation; create portfolio generation companies; freeze the free consumer threshold; replace cost based tariffs with an equalisation mechanism.
source_note: Read through a critical TEPAV note (2006), not the paper itself; the issuing body and exact date were not read.

title: First Balancing and Settlement Regulation (DUY)
label: DUY (2004)
effect: Handbook: named PMUM as market operator and MYTM as system operator; the earlier settlement communiqué (2003) stayed in use until 1 Aug 2006.
source_note: EPİAŞ market handbook (project document), section 2 and appendices. Not yet read in an official text.

title: Law 5346 on renewable energy for electricity generation
label: Law 5346
name_tr: Yenilenebilir Enerji Kaynaklarının Elektrik Enerjisi Üretimi Amaçlı Kullanımına İlişkin Kanun (5346)
effect: Article 6: schedule I prices apply for ten years to licensed plants in the support mechanism commissioned from 18 May 2005 to 31 Dec 2020; for later plants the President sets the prices, not above schedule I. The current text has EPİAŞ announce the total support charge and suppliers pay it by ratio.
source_note: Header and Article 6 read in the consolidated text; the schedules were not reproduced there.

title: Provisional balancing and settlement begins
label: Provisional settlement (2006)
effect: Handbook: hourly load-up and load-down instructions priced at the system marginal price (SMF); settlement monthly, three time zones.
source_note: EPİAŞ market handbook (project document), section 2 and appendices. Not yet read in an official text.

title: Law 5710 on nuclear power plants and energy sales
label: Law 5710
name_tr: Nükleer Güç Santrallarının Kurulması ve İşletilmesi ile Enerji Satışına İlişkin Kanun (5710)
effect: TETAŞ buys the electricity the selected company is contracted to produce, under a sales contract of up to 15 years from start of operation, and resells it to licensed companies in proportion to their share of national consumption.
source_note: Header and Articles 3 and 4 read. The page does not use the word 'guarantee'; it describes a purchase contract.

title: First Ancillary Services Regulation
label: Ancillary Services Reg. (2008)
effect: First ancillary services rules. The page marks it repealed; the 2017 regulation replaced it.
source_note: Header read (title, gazette number and date, issuing body).

title: Balancing and Settlement Regulation (DUY) in force today in amended form
label: DUY (2009)
name_tr: Elektrik Piyasası Dengeleme ve Uzlaştırma Yönetmeliği
relation: issued under Law 4628; the consolidated text now cites Law 6446
effect: Sets the rules for balancing, the day-ahead and intraday markets, imbalance and financial settlement. The consolidated text on the page cites Law 6446 as its basis. All later amendments below attach here.
source_note: Gazette number and date read here and in the EPİAŞ organisation regulation page. Whether it replaced the 2004 text was not read.

title: Day-ahead planning and balancing power market (DGP) start; hourly settlement begins
label: DGP launch (2009)
effect: Handbook: the first step towards the day-ahead market; settlement became hourly and consumers began to forecast their own consumption.
source_note: EPİAŞ market handbook (project document), section 2 and appendices. The EPİAŞ day-ahead brochure gives no date for this step.

title: Turkish grid joins the continental European system in trial parallel operation
label: Synchronous trial (2010)
effect: Two 400 kV lines to Bulgaria and one to Greece; a one year trial in three phases: stabilisation, non-commercial exchange, limited capacity allocation. The permanent agreement (14 Apr 2015) is from the handbook and not confirmed here.
source_note: Trade press, 2010.

title: Law 6094 amends the renewable energy law (YEKDEM period)
label: Law 6094
effect: Amended Article 3 and the support provisions of Law 5346. The handbook dates the start of the YEKDEM support mechanism to 2011. The price schedule was not read.
source_note: Adoption date read from the amendment notation '29/12/2010-6094/1' in the 5346 text. Gazette date not read.

title: Day-ahead market (GÖP) established
label: GÖP launch (2011)
effect: Start of the hourly day-ahead market that sets the PTF. The same handbook section dates the collateral and advance payment system to this time.
source_note: EPİAŞ day-ahead brochure: 'established on 1 December 2011'.

title: Law 6446, the Electricity Market Law
label: Law 6446
relation: succeeds (which articles of 4628 it repealed was not read)
effect: The main law today. The handbook says it merged wholesale and retail licences into a single supply licence. Its Article 3 defines the organised wholesale markets run by EPİAŞ, Borsa İstanbul and TEİAŞ; Article 11 is the basis of the EPİAŞ organisation regulation. Amended many times (rows below).
source_note: Header and Articles 1 to 3 read; the repeal article was not on the page, so which parts of 4628 it repealed is not confirmed here.

title: Distribution privatisation completed
label: Distribution privatisation
effect: Press report: the last sale completed the transfer of distribution to the private sector; 18 of 20 distribution companies sold for about 12.7 billion USD, the other two handled separately by the Ministry.
source_note: Single news item; the privatising body is not named on the page (ÖİB assumed).

title: Regulation on certification and support of renewable energy (YEK Regulation)
label: YEK Regulation (2013)
name_tr: Yenilenebilir Enerji Kaynaklarının Belgelendirilmesi ve Desteklenmesine İlişkin Yönetmelik
effect: Base regulation for the support mechanism; amended 11 May 2017 (handbook) and 10 Feb 2022, below.
source_note: Base date and number read from the 2022 amendment page.

title: Licence Regulation
label: Licence Regulation
effect: Rules for the licences and pre-licences needed to operate in the market. Amended many times; amendment of 17 Dec 2024 and 21 Jan 2025 exist (not read).
source_note: Header read; the licence types and terms were not on the page.

title: Import and Export Regulation
label: Import and Export Regulation
name_tr: Elektrik Piyasası İthalat ve İhracat Yönetmeliği
effect: Rules for cross-border electricity trade; amended in 2014 (29219), 2019 (30802) and 2021 (31464).
source_note: Base date and number read from the 2021 amendment page.

title: Grid Regulation
label: Grid Regulation
effect: Technical rules for the transmission and distribution grids. The Dec 2024 amendment (frequency modes, load shedding, demand side participation) is described in the handbook and not yet read.
source_note: Header read.

title: EPİAŞ organisation regulation
label: EPİAŞ organisation regulation
name_tr: Enerji Piyasaları İşletme A.Ş. Teşkilat Yapısı ve Çalışma Esasları Hakkında Yönetmelik
effect: Sets EPİAŞ's general assembly, board, committees and units.
source_note: EPİAŞ page; lists gazette numbers and dates.

title: Intraday market (GİP) opens
label: GİP launch (2015)
effect: Handbook: opened first under TEİAŞ, then moved to EPİAŞ.
source_note: EPİAŞ market handbook (project document), section 2 and appendices.

title: EPİAŞ takes over the day-ahead and intraday markets and imbalance settlement
label: EPİAŞ takeover
effect: TEİAŞ keeps the balancing power market and also holds a 49 year market operation licence.
source_note: News item and EPİAŞ transition announcement agree on 1 Sep 2015.

title: TEİAŞ becomes ENTSO-E observer member
label: ENTSO-E observer
effect: TEİAŞ states it was the first and only observer member. Why it matters for this site: ENTSO-E data covers only Bulgaria, Greece and Georgia for Türkiye.
source_note: TEİAŞ page.

title: Transparency Platform launched
label: Transparency Platform
effect: The source of most data on this site.
source_note: EPİAŞ market handbook (project document), section 2 and appendices. The handbook also gives an 18 March date for EPİAŞ's own founding.

title: Demand Forecasts Regulation
label: Demand Forecasts Regulation
effect: Sets the steps for demand forecasts made, assessed, updated and approved by TEİAŞ, industrial zones, distribution companies and suppliers of last resort. Art. 18 repeals the Demand Forecasts Regulation of 4 Apr 2006 (RG 26129). It rests on Laws 4628 and 6446.
source_note: Date and gazette number from EPDK's regulation list (screenshot supplied by the project owner). Content read in a text supplied by the user, which has no amendment marks and no gazette header, so it is taken to be the first version without confirming that.

title: Law 6719 introduces renewable energy resource areas (YEKA) into the market law
label: Law 6719
effect: Added Article 5 (12) to (14): resource areas, TEİAŞ connection opinions and capacity allocation, competitive tenders, guarantees. Also: nuclear plants may submit construction permits after the licence is granted; wind and solar licensees cannot transfer shares before provisional acceptance; distribution and supply companies are barred from wind and solar applications in their own area.
source_note: Ministry-hosted consolidated text, footnotes. Dates are as printed there (adoption dates); gazette dates were not read.

title: YEKA Regulation
label: YEKA Regulation
effect: The Ministry ranks areas and opens them in a use right competition that starts from a price ceiling and runs as an open auction to the lowest price; the winner signs within 30 days and applies for a pre-licence within 45 days.
source_note: Law firm note.

title: Competition rules for wind and solar pre-licence applications
label: Wind and solar competition Reg.
name_tr: Rüzgâr veya Güneş Enerjisine Dayalı Üretim Tesisi Kurmak Üzere Yapılan Önlisans Başvurularına İlişkin Yarışma Yönetmeliği
effect: When applications for a grid connection region exceed the capacity TEİAŞ announces, or several apply for the same site, TEİAŞ runs a competition. The winner is the lowest offer in US cents per kWh, which may not exceed the Law 5346 Schedule I price for the source, and the Schedule II rights stay in place.
source_note: Read in a consolidated text supplied by the user; the amendment table lists RG 30065, 30867 and 31441. What the two amendments changed was not read.

title: First large wind tender under YEKA: 1,000 MW
label: YEKA wind tender (2017)
effect: Winners reported as Siemens Gamesa, Kalyon and Türkerler. A news summary reports a winning price of 3.48 against a ceiling of 7.00 without stating the unit (US cents per kWh assumed, not confirmed).
source_note: Date from the Alomaliye news item URL; the Enerdata page's own text dates the proposals to 27 Jul 2017 and the article to 4 Aug 2017.

title: Ancillary Services Regulation (current)
label: Ancillary Services Reg. (2017)
effect: Replaces the 2008 text. Amended on 29 Dec 2025 (row below).
source_note: Header read.

title: Capacity Mechanism Regulation (2018, repealed in 2021)
label: Capacity Mechanism Reg. (2018)
effect: TEİAŞ proposes an annual budget that the EPDK board approves each November; paid to eligible plants by source type in proportion to installed capacity. Excludes plants with a public share above 50%, nuclear under international agreements, plants with YEKDEM support, wind and solar, and small plants (under 50 MW domestic resource, under 100 MW others).
source_note: Read in full. EPDK's regulation page (screenshot supplied by the project owner, cut off at the bottom) lists later versions: RG 31487 (21 May 2021), 31693 (18 Dec 2021, marked old version), 32416 5th mükerrer (31 Dec 2023), 32612 (25 Jul 2024) and 32771 (3 Jan 2025). Their content was not read. The 2021 regulation (see below), supplied as a consolidated text, repeals this one in its Art. 13.

title: Law 7103 lets licence-exempt storage and demand side participation into the market law
label: Law 7103
effect: Added electricity storage and demand side participation to the list in Article 14(1)(e), within limits set by the board; extended the stamp duty exemption for EPİAŞ related transactions to gas and other energy markets.
source_note: Ministry-hosted consolidated text, footnotes. Gazette date not read.

title: Consumer Services Regulation
label: Consumer Services Reg.
effect: Sets minimum standards for what a supply contract must contain and how consumers are served: bilateral contracts between suppliers and free consumers using under 100,000 kWh a year, retail sales contracts of suppliers of last resort, and what distribution companies do on meter access, illegal use, disconnection and reconnection.
source_note: Read in a consolidated text supplied by the user (amendment table: 30436, 31401, 31803, 32782). The 100,000 kWh wording comes from the Jan 2025 amendment mark; the earlier wording was not read.

title: Law 7162 adds forward physical delivery markets and EPİAŞ risk management
label: Law 7162
effect: Added forward physical delivery markets to the organised markets in Article 3; Article 11 (14) and (15) on EPİAŞ and clearing body risk management, collateral, default and the default guarantee account.
source_note: Ministry-hosted consolidated text, footnotes.

title: Law 7164 amends licensed renewable rules
label: Law 7164
effect: Measurement data period for wind and solar sites changed from five to eight years; capacity increases, modernisation and renewal of licensed renewable plants within approved areas allowed with a favourable connection opinion; rules for multi-source licences.
source_note: Ministry-hosted consolidated text, footnotes.

title: Unlicensed Electricity Generation Regulation
label: Unlicensed Generation Reg.
name_tr: Elektrik Piyasasında Lisanssız Elektrik Üretim Yönetmeliği
effect: Renewable plants up to 1 MW, or the upper limit set by the President, need no licence; offsetting of production against consumption in the same distribution region, with exceptions. Amended on 11 Aug 2022 (31920), 2 Mar 2023, 14 May 2024, 18 Dec 2024, 25 Nov 2025 (33088) and 2 Apr 2026 (the last four not read).
source_note: Consolidated text read; the 1 MW figure is as written there, the current presidential limit was not looked up.

title: EPDK board decision 8965-2: Power Futures Market operating procedures
label: Decision 8965-2
name_tr: Vadeli Elektrik Piyasası İşletim Usul ve Esasları (assumed to be this instrument)
instrument: EPDK decision 8965-2 (5 Dec 2019; Resmî Gazete 31027, 2 Feb 2020)
effect: Operating procedures of the forward electricity market; the page shows a consolidated version in force from 20 Feb 2025.
source_note: Title, date and gazette number read on the page.

title: Tariffs Regulation
label: Tariffs Regulation
effect: Defines the tariff types (connection, transmission, wholesale, distribution, retail, market operation, last resort supply) and the principles of revenue regulation.
source_note: Header and Article 5 read; the page was cut off, so whether it replaces an earlier text was not read.

title: Presidential decision extends the support deadline by six months
label: Support deadline decision (2020)
instrument: Presidential decision, Resmî Gazete 18 Sep 2020 (number not read)
effect: Moved the commissioning deadline for support from 31 Dec 2020 to 30 Jun 2021; plants commissioned between 1 Jan and 30 Jun 2021 get the set prices until 31 Dec 2030.
source_note: Law firm note; decision number not stated.

title: Renewable Energy Guarantee Certificate (YEK-G) Regulation
label: YEK-G Regulation
name_tr: Elektrik Piyasasında Yenilenebilir Enerji Kaynak Garanti Belgesi Yönetmeliği
effect: The market operator issues YEK-G certificates, one per MWh, as proof that supplied electricity came from renewable sources; they can be traded.
source_note: Header and Article 5 read.

title: Law 7257 sets the support charge in lira and eases self-consumption renewables
label: Law 7257
effect: Support charge in lira; incentives for renewable plants built for own consumption; the maximum refund period for distribution grid investment by generation and consumption facilities cut from 10 to 5 years.
source_note: Law firm note.

title: Free consumer limit cut to 1,200 kWh for 2021
label: Free consumer limit (2021)
instrument: EPDK decision 9814 (17 Dec 2020; Resmî Gazete 31342, 22 Dec 2020)
effect: Down from 1,400 kWh. The note says 'per year' only implicitly.
source_note: Law firm note, which contains a typo in the effective year.

title: Presidential decision 3453 sets renewable support prices in lira
label: Decision 3453
effect: Support prices in lira for plants commissioned from 1 Jul 2021 to 31 Dec 2025. Press report: hydro 40, wind and solar 32, geothermal 54 kuruş per kWh, with 8 kuruş for domestic equipment. The Feb 2022 amendment below pays the domestic equipment price as a support charge to plants outside the mechanism.
source_note: Decision number and date read in the Feb 2022 regulation text; lira prices from a press report (Sözcü, 30 Jan 2021), gazette date not read.

title: DUY amendment on invoice objections
label: DUY amendment (2021)
effect: Objections to settlement invoices: in writing within 60 days of delivery and no later than 12 months after the invoice period; the market operator decides within 3 months and corrects other errors it finds.
source_note: Read in full.

title: Import and Export Regulation amendment
label: Import and Export amendment (2021)
effect: Limits export by generation licensees to their installed capacity; sets how suppliers and generators bid for capacity on synchronous links, the guarantees, resale of transmission rights, loss of unused rights, congestion charges and use of congestion revenue.
source_note: Read in full.

title: Storage Activities Regulation
label: Storage Regulation
effect: Four storage types: with a generation plant, with a consumption facility, standalone (supply licence holders, at least 2 MW) and built by network operators. Pumped hydro excluded. The same day, five other regulations (licence, DUY, grid, connection, YEK) were amended to cover storage.
source_note: Law firm note; number and date also match the Alomaliye page.

title: Power Futures Market (VEP) opens
label: VEP launch (2021)
effect: Reported first trade at 13:00 on 1 June 2021 for the October 2021 base contract at 405 lira per MWh; EPİAŞ acts as central counterparty.
source_note: News item; the clearing role of Takasbank is from the handbook.

title: Capacity Mechanism Regulation replaced in 2021 and changed in 2023, 2025
label: Capacity Mechanism Reg. (2021)
instrument: Resmî Gazete 31693 (amended 31 Dec 2023, 25 Jul 2024, 3 Jan 2025, 31 Dec 2025)
relation: issued under Art. 20; repeals the 2018 regulation (kapasite-2018)
effect: TEİAŞ runs the mechanism and pays licensed plants from a yearly budget the board approves in January, counted in transmission tariffs. In the current text half of each billing period's budget is paid by installed capacity per source type and half by a formula that favours domestic sources and compares the day-ahead price with fixed and variable cost components. Excluded: plants with a public share above 50%, build-operate-transfer plants, nuclear, YEKDEM plants, wind, hydro and solar, and plants under 50 MW (domestic resources) or 100 MW (others). A plant gets no payment in a month in which 20% or more of its balancing instructions go unfulfilled (rule added Dec 2023, rewritten Dec 2025).
source_note: Read in the consolidated text supplied by the user (Art. 13 repeals the 2018 regulation). What the Dec 2023 and 2025 amendments replaced, and what the two repealed exclusion criteria were, is not in the text.

title: YEK Regulation amendment on the domestic equipment price
label: YEK amendment (2022)
effect: Plants commissioned after 30 Jun 2021 outside YEKDEM that use domestic equipment are paid the domestic equipment price set in decision 3453, added to the total support charge.
source_note: Read in full.

title: EPDK board decisions on the maximum day-ahead and balancing price (series)
label: Price cap decisions
relation: decisions under the price limits procedure that EPDK lists beneath the DUY (procedure itself not read)
effect: EPDK's list names the procedure: 'Gün Öncesi Piyasasında ve Dengeleme Güç Piyasasında Asgari ve Azami Fiyat Limitlerinin Belirlenmesine İlişkin Usul ve Esaslar', with an amendment by board decision 10890. First verified step in the table: 2,500 TL/MWh from 1 Apr 2022. Latest verified: 4,500 TL/MWh on 3 Apr 2026. Every step with its source is in price_caps.csv and drawn on the Prices page.
source_note: Internal table; each row has its own source and status. Procedure name from EPDK's regulation page (https://www.epdk.gov.tr/Detay/Icerik/3-0-159-3/yonetmelikler); its date was not shown.

title: EV charging: Charging Services Regulation
label: Charging Regulation
effect: Charging network operators need an EPDK licence (up to 49 years, minimum capital 4.5 million TL); at least 50 units in at least 5 districts within 6 months; fees must follow costs plus a reasonable margin, with EPDK able to set minimum and maximum prices; existing providers had 4 months to comply.
source_note: Law firm note; number and date from this note.

title: Law 7417 allows wind and solar pre-licences tied to storage commitments
label: Law 7417
effect: Companies that commit to building storage can get a pre-licence for wind or solar up to the storage capacity, exempt from the measurement and competition rules; existing licensed plants may add capacity if they build storage; the electricity can benefit from YEKDEM.
source_note: Law firm note.

title: Law 7429 amends the market law; aggregation enters the law
label: Law 7429
effect: Law firms give 22 Dec 2022 as the date aggregation entered the market law (Article 12/A). That the aggregation article is in Law 7429 is inferred from the date, not read.
source_note: Number and gazette read; aggregation link inferred.

title: Unlicensed Generation Regulation amendment on mixed sites and single acceptance
label: Unlicensed amendment (2023)
effect: Where licensed and unlicensed plants share a metering point, connection agreements must show zero net injection; energy that still flows to the grid is excluded from settlement and counted as a free contribution to YEKDEM. Offsetting across supplier regions from 1 Jul 2023.
source_note: Read in full.

title: DUY amendment: new intraday bid types and matching rules from 1 Jan 2024
label: DUY amendment (intraday, 2023)
effect: Hourly contracts with partial amounts; standard, time limited, fill or kill, fill and kill, price tiered, time tiered and iceberg bids; trades at the price of the bid entered first; objection window 15 minutes, with a fee of 1,000 TL per rejected objection. The handbook adds that block bids were removed.
source_note: Read in full; the text does not use the term 'block orders'.

title: Metering Systems Regulation
label: Metering Systems Reg.
instrument: Resmî Gazete 32413 (effective 1 Jan 2024; amended 2024 and 21 Jan 2026)
effect: Covers all metering systems for licensed and unlicensed generation and for consumption: equipment, installation, data processing and sharing, and who does what. It defines smart meters (a PRO type with two-way communication and a more limited EKO type) and the national smart meter system. Art. 17 repeals the 2015 automatic meter reading procedure (RG 29439) and the 2003 Communiqué on meters (RG 25056).
source_note: Read in a consolidated text supplied by the user (amendment table: 32413, 32569, 32673, 32759, 33144).

title: Free consumer limit cut to 750 kWh for 2025
label: Free consumer limit (2025)
instrument: EPDK decision (number and date not read)
effect: Down from 950 kWh in 2024.
source_note: Article dated 17 Dec 2024; the decision date is not stated there.

title: Aggregation Regulation
label: Aggregation Regulation
effect: Aggregators act for grid users that are not market participants; licensed or supply licence endorsed. Per the handbook: portfolio up to 2,000 MW, of which unlicensed at most 500 MW; units whose 10 year purchase guarantee has ended may join. First licences in 2025 (handbook). Eight other regulations were amended the same day.
source_note: Law firm note for number, date and effective date; capacity limits from the handbook.

title: DUY amendment: 15-minute settlement period for balancing power, storage and unlicensed rules
label: DUY amendment (Jan 2025)
effect: Art. 91(2) says the settlement period in the balancing power market is fifteen minutes; temporary Art. 40 requires the system and market operators to finish the infrastructure by 1 Jan 2027 and says nothing under that paragraph starts before that date. Art. 81/A requires storage inside generation plants to be available at 85% of licensed electric capacity for the first five years after acceptance and 80% after. Art. 75(3) lets instruction costs for unlicensed plants be passed on to the aggregator or supplier of last resort. The statement in the handbook that this amendment lets the board set k and l was not found in the DUY text: k and l already appear in temporary Art. 21 from 2011.
source_note: Read in the consolidated DUY text supplied by the user (amendment marks RG-21/1/2025-32789 and the amendment table). The gazette issue itself was not opened.

title: Storage amendments: availability rule, new licence conditions
label: Storage amendment (Jan 2025)
effect: The gazette text adds a definition of availability for storage in generation plants and a 10% tolerance at acceptance. A news report on the whole package (licence, storage and grid regulations): storage in generation plants must be available 85% of the time for five years, then 80%; energy from failing storage is credited to YEKDEM for free; the balancing market settlement period moves to 15 minutes, with infrastructure ready by 1 Jan 2027.
source_note: Gazette text for the storage amendment; the rest from a news report (Ekonomi Gazetesi), not read in the gazette.

title: Climate Law 7552 creates the emissions trading system; EPİAŞ becomes its market operator
label: Law 7552
effect: The Climate Change Presidency sets up the system and allocates allowances; the market operator named in the law is EPİAŞ and runs the market, financial settlement and the registry. Market manipulation fines of the Electricity Market Law extend to this market.
source_note: Read.

title: Law 7554 extends land-fee discounts for plants using certain mined fuels
label: Law 7554
effect: Temporary Art. 4(4) of Law 6446 gives 85% off permit, rent, easement and use fees to plants entering operation by a set date that use Group IV(b) minerals of the Mining Law 3213 as input under a Ministry mining licence (which minerals that covers was not looked up), covering access roads and grid lines. Law 7554 moved the date from 31 Dec 2020 to 31 Dec 2030 and the discount period from ten to fifteen years.
source_note: Date and number as printed in a footnote of the consolidated Law 6446 supplied by the user; the gazette number of Law 7554 was not shown. The Presidential decision 10707 (RG 33112, 19 Dec 2025) cited in the same text extends a period in another article, which was not identified.

title: Free consumer limit cut to 500 kWh for 2026
label: Free consumer limit (2026)
instrument: EPDK decision 14039 (18 Dec 2025; Resmî Gazete 33116, 23 Dec 2025)
effect: Effective 1 Jan 2026.
source_note: News item with decision number and gazette number.

title: DUY amendment: imbalance coefficients depend on system direction from 2026
label: DUY amendment (Dec 2025)
instrument: Resmî Gazete 33122 (effective 1 Jan 2026); EPDK decision 14030 (11 Dec 2025)
effect: Art. 110(1) and (2) were rewritten. The coefficient k applies to negative and l to positive imbalance, each set by the board between 0 and 1 and depending on the system direction in the settlement period. The values are not in the DUY text. The handbook gives, from 1 Jan 2026, k=0.06 and l=0.03 in an energy deficit and k=0.03 and l=0.06 in a surplus; those numbers come from decision 14030, which was not read.
source_note: Structure read in the consolidated DUY text supplied by the user (marks RG-29/12/2025-33122, effective date footnote 1/1/2026). Coefficient values from the handbook, section 21; decision 14030 not read.

title: Storage amendment: storage at unlicensed plants and rules for hybrid plants
label: Storage amendment (Dec 2025)
effect: Storage allowed at unlicensed plants under conditions; energy exported from that storage is unpaid and counted as a free contribution to YEKDEM; output of plants with storage capped by the accepted storage capacity; storage can take part in ancillary services and the balancing power market; new annex for connecting standalone storage.
source_note: Read; the annexes were not available on the page.

title: YEK Regulation amendment on who is eligible and how storage-linked energy is treated
label: YEK amendment (Dec 2025)
instrument: EPDK regulation, effective 1 Jan 2026 (gazette number not read)
effect: Press report: capacity increases approved from 28 Feb 2019 get no YEKDEM support for the added capacity; energy a storage-linked plant draws from the grid, and energy from auxiliary sources in integrated storage, is excluded from YEKDEM.
source_note: News item only; not yet read in the gazette.

title: Ancillary Services amendment: imbalance refund for secondary frequency control, aggregators
label: Ancillary amendment (Dec 2025)
effect: Secondary frequency control providers that are also balancing market participants receive an imbalance refund on top of the reserve payment; TEİAŞ announces capacity procurement specifications at least 90 days ahead; rules for aggregators in ancillary services (capacity payment lost if registered capacity falls below the procured amount).
source_note: Read.

title: Retail electricity tariffs raised: residential 25%
label: Tariff decision (Apr 2026)
instrument: EPDK tariff decision, effective 4 Apr 2026 (number not read)
effect: Press report: residential +25%, low voltage public and private services +17.5%, medium voltage industry +5.8%, medium voltage agriculture +24.8%; gas tariffs raised on BOTAŞ wholesale prices (about 19.4% for power plants). The same day, the day-ahead price cap was raised to 4,500 TL/MWh (price_caps.csv).
source_note: News item.

title: Board decision 14531: settlement rules for unlicensed plants and their consumption points
label: Unlicensed settlement procedure
name_tr: Lisanssız Elektrik Üretim Tesisleri ve İlişkili Olduğu Tüketim Tesislerinin Mahsuplaşma İşlemlerine İlişkin Usul ve Esaslar
relation: procedure under Art. 26 of the Unlicensed Generation Regulation
effect: Procedure and principles for the settlement (mahsuplaşma) the market operator runs for unlicensed plants and the consumption points tied to them. It covers plants offset under Art. 23, plants past their ten-year support period and those set up under Art. 30(8), and introduces an unlicensed production module (LUM) as the settlement unit.

title: Ancillary Services amendment: demand-side participation rules for aggregators
label: Ancillary amendment (Oct 2026)
effect: Art. 31/C(3)(a): an aggregator's demand-side application adds a document, approved by the distribution licensee, with meter data and contract power of consumption points. Art. 31/E(3): payments to aggregators after critical months are a monthly capacity fee plus an activation fee when an instruction is carried out. Art. 31/F(6): monitoring per instructed hour: a shortfall of up to 10% of the instructed amount counts as delivered, 10% to 25% as not delivered and 25% or more as non-participation; over-delivery of up to 50% counts as delivered, more as not delivered, unless TEİAŞ approved it at least an hour before. Art. 31/G: the capacity fee is reduced by the share of non-participation hours in instructed hours. The date in temporary Art. 12 moves from 1 Sep 2026 to 31 Dec 2026 (the subject of that article was not checked).
source_note: Gazette text of Resmî Gazete 33405 supplied by the user (PDF of the gazette page, read in full).

title: Connection and System Usage amendment: storage above contract power, collateral, leaving the distribution system
label: Connection amendment (Oct 2026)
relation: amends (base regulation not in the timeline yet)
effect: Art. 14(10): consumers who want storage with installed power above their contract power must install an automatic power control unit and an energy cut-off system, so nothing flows to the grid and withdrawal stays within contract power. Art. 16(4): licensed generators cannot leave the distribution system while licensed, except to connect to transmission after amending the licence's connection point. Art. 21(2): the item due with the connection agreement is now due within 30 days after signing. Art. 24: collateral for the distribution system use agreement is a bank letter, cash or e-letter, extra collateral is due within ten business days of a notice, excess is returned within ten business days on request, a shortfall of 20% or more is reported to EPDK, and the ceiling ratio is at most 1x for users who paid all system use invoices for 24 months. Temporary Art. 15 returns excess collateral within a month.
source_note: Gazette text of Resmî Gazete 33405 supplied by the user (PDF of the gazette page, read in full).

title: Seven EPDK board decisions (14907 to 14913), taken 24 Sep 2026: deviation coefficients and tolerances, unlicensed connection agreements, storage licence guarantees
label: Board decisions 14907 to 14913
relation: decisions under the DUY and related regulations (links not read)
effect: Press reports: 14907 sets the coefficients and tolerance values for production-plan deviation, with different tolerances for wind, solar, storage and other sources; 14908 sets which unfulfilled load-increase and load-decrease instructions are excluded from reporting; 14909 amends the unlicensed connection agreement (remote monitoring and control, sanctions); 14910 covers reporting of offer prices (hydro excluded); 14911 sets the value used in the energy imbalance amount at 100 TL/MWh; 14912 updates capital and guarantee wording for standalone storage licence applications; 14913 amends the reactive power control agreement. One report says the consumption provisions of 14907 apply from 1 Jan 2027; that is not confirmed in the other reports read. KÜPSM and KÜPST do not appear in any report read.
source_note: Title, date and gazette number read on Alomaliye's listing of the 19 Oct 2026 gazette; the content is from press reports, since the gazette text could not be opened from here. Reports: urfadabugun, Yeşil Haber.

title: Storage amendment: consumer storage above contract power
label: Storage amendment (Oct 2026)
effect: Art. 6(1) now says consumers may build storage if the network operator gives a suitable connection opinion and it sits at the same metering point; consumers who want storage with installed power above contract power must install the units and systems named in Art. 14 of the Connection and System Usage Regulation. This amendment is one article; the power-instead-of-capacity changes for licences are in the Licence Regulation amendment.
source_note: Gazette text of Resmî Gazete 33405 supplied by the user (PDF of the gazette page, read in full). The text does not use MWe or MWh.

title: DUY amendment: settlement-period wording, emergency instructions to unlicensed plants and storage
label: DUY amendment (Oct 2026)
instrument: Resmî Gazete 33405 (28 articles, effective on publication)
effect: Day-ahead schedules (KGÜP), balancing bids and instruction reconciliation are stated per settlement period, and the word hourly is removed or replaced in a handful of provisions, not throughout. The settlement period itself is unchanged: Art. 91 keeps one hour, with fifteen minutes for the balancing power market only from 1 Jan 2027 at the earliest. Art. 75 lets the system operator give emergency instructions to unbid generation, unlicensed plants (distribution-connected: through the supplier of last resort or aggregator, starting with plants of 900 kW and above operating electric capacity, largest first) and standalone storage, and sets the settlement price; aggregators must set up remote control. Art. 110 has new imbalance formulas and Art. 110(6) sets how the deviation payment is worked out for aggregator portfolio plants, with tolerance coefficients left to a board decision. Temporary Art. 41 starts load-change-curve instructions for thermal units on 1 Jan 2027. SCADA, MWe units and consumption-side deviation from 2027 are not in this text.
source_note: Amendment text (28 articles) and consolidated DUY text, both supplied by the user. The gazette issue itself was not opened. Press reports (Enerji Günlüğü, Foreks) gave the first summary.

title: Licence Regulation amendment: storage power, guarantee return, company titles, force majeure
label: Licence amendment (Oct 2026)
effect: 'Capacity' becomes 'power' in Arts. 12(5)(f), 20(4)(ç), 20(6) and 24(19)(b). For plants with storage, documents under Art. 18(5)(a) count the storage unit's power. Art. 45(7): the guarantee given with a licence application for a storage-integrated plant is not returned until the whole plant is in operation, and guarantee return for storage units follows the power of the accepted unit. Arts. 34(15) and 34/A(7) bar company titles that give the impression of a link with another firm (the old text barred identical ones). Art. 35(6): a force majeure event the board accepted earlier is no longer considered once it becomes permanent and prevents completing the investment.
source_note: Gazette text of Resmî Gazete 33405 supplied by the user (PDF of the gazette page, read in full). The text says power (güç) but names no unit such as MWe.

title: Unlicensed Generation amendment: remote control, unpaid output on missed instructions, 60 days to revise agreements
label: Unlicensed amendment (Oct 2026)
effect: New Art. 21(8): distribution companies and distribution-licensed industrial zones and regions may remotely control distribution-connected unlicensed plants covered by Art. 75(4) of the DUY during an emergency, must tell owners within 15 minutes of the emergency ending (by phone and durable medium), and re-energising is the owner's responsibility. New additional Art. 4: an unlicensed plant that ignores an emergency load-shedding instruction gets nothing for the output matching the unfulfilled part, priced at the Law 5346 Schedule I price, the price under Presidential decision 11415 (12 Jun 2026) or the tariff price, and the amount is collected from the producer. Temporary Art. 14: affected producers have 60 days to apply to revise their connection agreement to the board's standard, and the penalty clauses in Art. 16(1)(f) and (g) of that agreement are not applied before 30 Apr 2027. Art. 28(4) changes how plant internal consumption is offset or billed. No mention of SCADA.
source_note: Gazette text of Resmî Gazete 33405 supplied by the user (PDF of the gazette page, read in full).

title: Industrial Zones amendment: duties on emergency instructions
label: Industrial Zones amendment (Oct 2026)
relation: amends (base regulation not in the timeline yet)
effect: Organised industrial zones (OSB) and industrial regions (EB) with a distribution licence must carry out load-shedding instructions for unlicensed plants passed on by suppliers of last resort and instructions from TEİAŞ under the emergency measures of the Grid Regulation, and must share data on unlicensed plants and on carrying out instructions with the suppliers and TEİAŞ (Arts. 7(3)-(4), 11(4)-(5)). Failure brings the sanctions of Art. 16 of Law 6446.

title: YEK Regulation amendment: virtual records for storage, YEKDEM cost formulas
label: YEK amendment (Oct 2026)
effect: Art. 5(7) and new (12) and (13): for storage at a generation plant, energy from the plant stored and then fed to the grid counts under YEKDEM only if the virtual records show it was produced after joining YEKDEM; energy drawn from the grid is treated as discharged first and outside YEKDEM; records are capped at the unit's operating capacity and cut proportionally when exceeded; for a plant joining YEKDEM, stored energy already in the records at the start gets no YEKDEM payment. Art. 23(6): for licensed plants under emergency or balancing instructions in surplus periods when the price is below a set level, production above the expected level counts as YEKDEM only if the day-ahead price is at or above the YEK price plus any domestic equipment price. Arts. 12 and 18: the YEKDEM total and YEK payment formulas add the cost of unfulfilled unlicensed instructions. Art. 27: false or misleading documents mean removal from the YEK list and recovery with interest.
